trials.claim: Plan 1 includes lifetime access to Insecure Web
trials.claimQuote:
- Lifetime access to Insecure Web
- You must redeem your code(s) within 60 days of purchase
- All future Pay as you go Plan updates
trials.reasoning: A reviewer explicitly calls the purchase an Ltd, supporting that it was sold as a lifetime deal. The other review only reports a temporary verification delay, not that lifetime access was denied or ended.

exhibits.quote: Unfortunately, I don’t have access to the full functionality until this is sorted out.
exhibits.argument: Buyer reports lifetime access is blocked pending company verification, so full functionality is not actually available.

exhibits.quote: This is hands down the best Ltd on here.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer explicitly calls the purchase an Ltd, confirming it is sold as a lifetime deal.

trials.claim: Plan 1 includes unlimited threat intelligence research
trials.claimQuote:
- Monitor up to 4 threat intelligence entities
- Unlimited threat intelligence research
- Unlimited threat intelligence feed download
- Whitelabel
- CNAME
- API access
trials.reasoning: The review says credits were consumed after adding 5 domains, but it does not say threat intelligence research itself is limited or consumes credits. This does not prove or disprove unlimited research.

exhibits.quote: I added 5 domains and didn’t realize how quickly my credits would be consumed.
exhibits.argument: Research consumes credits quickly, which contradicts the claim that threat intelligence research is unlimited.

trials.claim: Plan 2 includes unlimited threat intelligence feed download
trials.claimQuote:
- Monitor up to 8 threat intelligence entities
- Unlimited threat intelligence research
- Unlimited threat intelligence feed download
- Whitelabel
- CNAME
- API access
trials.reasoning: The review mentions rapid credit use after adding domains, but says nothing about threat intelligence feed downloads being capped. It neither confirms nor contradicts unlimited feed download.

exhibits.quote: I added 5 domains and didn’t realize how quickly my credits would be consumed.
exhibits.argument: Feed use is constrained by rapid credit consumption, which contradicts the claim of unlimited feed download.

trials.claimQuote:
- Stack up to 3 codes
- 50 credits per month
- Up to 4 company impersonation domains
- Monitor up to 4 threat intelligence entities
trials.reasoning: Extra credit-card charges do not show how many credits were included each month, or whether the buyer used more than an included allowance. The exhibit does not verify or contradict the 50-credits-per-month claim.

exhibits.quote: After a few weeks, I logged in and noticed that several payments had been charged to my credit card.
exhibits.argument: Buyer incurred extra card charges within weeks, undermining that 50 credits per month covers included use.

trials.claim: Plan 1 allows up to 4 company impersonation domains
trials.claimQuote:
- 50 credits per month
- Up to 4 company impersonation domains
- Monitor up to 4 threat intelligence entities
- Unlimited threat intelligence research
trials.reasoning: The buyer describes trouble accessing a first organisation after adding a second, which is about organisations and access, not a stated limit on company impersonation domains. It does not prove the 4-domain allowance is unavailable.

exhibits.quote: When I enter two organisations (thought this might be something like areas to organise domains), I can not access the first one after entering the second.
exhibits.argument: Buyer cannot reliably use even two organisations, undermining the claim of up to 4 domains.

trials.claim: Plan 1 includes all future Pay as you go Plan updates
trials.claimQuote:
- All future Pay as you go Plan updates
- Stack up to 3 codes
- 50 credits per month
- Up to 4 company impersonation domains
trials.reasoning: The review reports that upcoming penetration tests were said in Q&A to be coming and included for credits, supporting inclusion of a future feature. The same quote does not show future updates are excluded from the plan.

exhibits.quote: In the QA they mentioned penetration tests are coming and will be included for credits.
exhibits.argument: Upcoming functionality will cost extra credits, undermining that all future plan updates are included.

exhibits.quote: In the QA they mentioned penetration tests are coming and will be included for credits.
exhibits.argument: The reviewer confirms upcoming features will be included, supporting the promise of future plan updates.
